Package fr.imta.smartgrid.service

Class GridService

java.lang.Object
fr.imta.smartgrid.service.GridService
public class GridService extends Object
Business service for CRUD and analytics operations on Grid entities. Manages JPA transactions and Grid-Person-Sensor associations. Provides methods to compute total production and consumption for a Grid.

      public Grid create(String name, String description, List<Integer> personIds, List<Integer> sensorIds)
      Creates a new Grid and persists it to the database.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the Grid
      description - the description of the Grid
      personIds - the list of Person IDs to associate
      sensorIds - the list of Sensor IDs to associate
      Returns:
      the created Grid
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if name or description are null
      jakarta.persistence.EntityNotFoundException - if an associated Person or Sensor does not exist
